statement: Canonical local split WG coordinates give exact simultaneously attainable minimum positive rank negative rank and common coefficient degree via explicit integer and torsion-bit formulas
depends_on: C:effective-henselian-DVR-WG; C:finite-field-henselization-WG; C:arithmetic-henselization-WG; finite residue-field hermitian monoids
notes: An isolated symmetric torsion bit with zero integer coefficient requires one indecomposable on each side; other nonzero integer coordinates absorb their determinant bit without extra copies. Generator rank weights are n for symmetric/unitary and2n for alternating/paired. Maximum supported indecomposable degree is exact.

statement: Split WG over arbitrary products of solved henselian local factors injects into canonical coordinate groups with image exactly families of uniformly bounded explicit minimum ranks and degrees; operations are coordinatewise
depends_on: C:henselian-minimal-form-bounds; C:integral-orthogonal-coalgebras; C:profinite-projective-data; local hermitian cancellation
notes: Includes mixed-characteristic arithmetic henselizations and arbitrary variable local ranks through bounded idempotents. No global cancellation assumed. No finite decision of equality or boundedness of an arbitrary infinite family claimed. R0^N for R0=Fq[t]_(t)^h is non-Noetherian and admits no profinite ring topology.
